PATH = /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin

CRON_TZ=Asia/Tokyo
0 1 * * * root /usr/local/bin/first
# Mail nothing from here on.

QUERY=a=b&c=d
NOTE=several words here
@reboot root /usr/local/bin/warm-cache
30 2 * * mon-fri backup /usr/local/bin/second --full
EMPTY=''
